# 7. Ghosts/Antags
Even bad guys follow their own rules.
- When taking a ghost role, follow its set of rules unless told otherwise by an admin. -- Spamming ahelp asking for an exception will likely lead to a ban. - Non-antagonists must not work with antagonists and vice-versa. - Antagonist roles are [bold]expected[/bold] to act hostile towards non-antagonists unless there is a very good reason to do otherwise. -- Antagonists include xenomorphs, nuclear operatives, space dragons, and zombies. - Free agents [bold]may[/bold] act hostile towards non-antagonists or not, at their discretion.
